# kasiAIhub

> Practical AI business systems training for South African community and small businesses — sales-first, hands-on, and built around working systems, not notes.

kasiAIhub runs the Entrepreneur AI Journey: a practical, hands-on programme where entrepreneurs build real business systems with AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT and Lovable. Session 1 (Think & Plan) produces the Customer Pipeline Starter — a clearer offer, an ideal-customer profile, prospect starting points and a follow-up rhythm. Session 2 (Build & Create) delivers the Customer Conversion System, and Session 3 (Brand & Grow) the Market Visibility Engine. An optional advanced Session 4 sets up a Supervised Digital Team with approval gates. Classes are small (up to 8 learners), run Monday to Friday, 9am–3pm, in Gauteng. Sessions are R1,500 each, the 3-session Core Journey bundle is R4,000, and Session 4 is R4,500.
